enough.line: I asked the room if I'd said enough
stanza: I asked the room if I'd said enough
No one really answered
They just said "Don't go, don't go
Don't go, don't go, don't go"
All this leaving is never ending
I kept hoping for one more question
Or for someone to say
"Who do you think you are?"
So I could tell them

enough.line: If you lean your head out far enough
stanza: Dr. Filth, he keeps his world

But all his sexless patients
They are trying to blow it up
Now his nurse, some local loser
She's in charge of the cyanide hole
And she also keeps the cards that read
"Have mercy on his soul"
They all play on the pennywhistle
You can hear them blow
If you lean your head out far enough
From Desolation Row

enough.line: I could have caught up with her easy enough
stanza: She took off a silver locket

And in the roar of dust and diesel
I stood and watched her walk away
I could have caught up with her easy enough
But something must have made me stay

stanza: My father died a year ago today
